dataset_description: Digital marketing campaign performance data for FY 2024 across all channels and regions, tracking spend, reach, engagement, and revenue attribution.
business_context: A consumer brand's performance marketing team uses this data to optimise budget allocation across channels, measure campaign ROI, and identify the best-performing audience segments.

channel.description: Marketing channel (Google Ads, Meta, Email, etc.)

spend_usd.description: Total media spend for this campaign run

impressions.description: Total number of ad impressions served

conversions.description: Number of desired actions completed (purchase, signup, etc.)

revenue_generated_usd.description: Revenue directly attributed to this campaign

target_audience.description: Age bracket of the targeted audience

ab_test_variant.description: A/B test variant used for this run (Control, Variant A, Variant B)
